input/pad_rb.meaning: Gamepad right bumper (the shape leans to its side; no letters)

input/pad_rs.meaning: Gamepad right stick (the lit dot below marks the side)

input/pad_rs_click.meaning: Gamepad right stick press (a press chevron; the lit dot marks the side)

input/pad_rt.meaning: Gamepad right trigger (the shape leans to its side; no letters)

input/pad_south.meaning: Gamepad south face button (a lit stud in the south position; no colours, no letters)

input/pad_view.meaning: Gamepad view button (a small centre pill with a window mark; no trademark glyph)

input/pad_west.meaning: Gamepad west face button (a lit stud in the west position; no colours, no letters)

kits/brax_e.meaning: Brax E: Furnace Rush. Charge through a horde line, dragging enemies with you. Icon: a charging shoulder with drag lines.
kits/brax_e.motif: a charging shoulder with drag lines

kits/brax_passive.meaning: Brax passive: Heat Gauge. Sustained fire builds Heat; at max, attacks ignite and stagger, and Brax takes reduced burn damage. Icon: a flame thermometer.

kits/brax_q.meaning: Brax Q: Cinder Uppercut. Launch enemies skyward; the follow-up slam spawns flame geysers. Icon: a rising fist over a flame geyser.
kits/brax_q.motif: a rising fist over a flame geyser

kits/brax_r.meaning: Brax R (ultimate): Meltdown. 8s of molten fists: strikes emit shockwaves that copy your Mechanism. Icon: two dripping molten fists.

kits/epoch_e.meaning: Epoch E: Rewind Wounds. Revert the last 3s of damage taken by you or the most-hurt ally nearby. Icon: a turning-back arrow around a heart.
kits/epoch_e.motif: a turning-back arrow around a heart

kits/epoch_passive.meaning: Epoch passive: Borrowed Time. Cooldowns tick 40% faster while moving. Icon: an hourglass with a stride arrow.
kits/epoch_passive.motif: an hourglass with a stride arrow

kits/epoch_q.meaning: Epoch Q: Still Field. Bubble that slows enemies and projectiles inside. Icon: a bubble of paused motes.

kits/epoch_r.meaning: Epoch R (ultimate): Stolen Second. Freeze enemies for 2s; when time resumes, every ally's cooldowns reset. Icon: a clock with its wedge pulled away.
kits/epoch_r.motif: a clock with its wedge pulled away

kits/fenra_e.meaning: Fenra E: Den Call. Summon a howl that roots nearby enemies. Icon: a howling wolf over roots.

kits/fenra_passive.meaning: Fenra passive: Pack Bond. Your Chimera-pup copies your current Mechanism. Icon: a paw and a gear.

kits/fenra_q.meaning: Fenra Q: Sic 'Em. Send the pup to maul a target. Icon: the pup pouncing.

kits/fenra_r.meaning: Fenra R (ultimate): Wild Hunt. The pup grows colossal for 8s. Icon: a snarling wolf over a small one.
kits/fenra_r.motif: a snarling wolf over a small one

kits/kael_e.meaning: Kael E: Shadow Roll. Roll with i-frames; your next 3 shots pierce. Icon: a crescent rolling with afterimages.

kits/kael_passive.meaning: Kael passive: Ghost Step. Each kill grants a short dash refresh + stacking crit chance (decays). Icon: a footprint with a ghost trail.
kits/kael_passive.motif: a footprint with a ghost trail

kits/kael_q.meaning: Kael Q: Fan of Blades. Spectral shotgun burst that Marks; crits on Marked enemies below 15% HP execute. Icon: three blades fanned from one grip.
kits/kael_q.motif: three blades fanned from one grip

kits/kael_r.meaning: Kael R (ultimate): Bullet Ballet. 6s of infinite dash and twin spectral pistols copying your Mechanism. Icon: twin pistols spinning back to back.
kits/kael_r.motif: twin pistols spinning back to back

kits/lyra_e.meaning: Lyra E: Dirge. Enemies nearby are cursed. Icon: a falling note over a hex eye.
kits/lyra_e.motif: a falling note over a hex eye

kits/lyra_passive.meaning: Lyra passive: Crescendo. Damage auras scale with ally kill-streaks. Icon: a swelling hairpin under a note.
kits/lyra_passive.motif: a swelling hairpin under a note

kits/lyra_q.meaning: Lyra Q: Hymn of Haste. Allies gain fire rate. Icon: a winged note.

kits/lyra_r.meaning: Lyra R (ultimate): Last Chorus. Every ally's damage is amplified for 8s. Icon: a lyre in ringing arcs.

kits/mirren_e.meaning: Mirren E: Snatch. Teleport-strike an elite and steal its momentum. Icon: a hand closing on a gem.
kits/mirren_e.motif: a hand closing on a gem

kits/mirren_passive.meaning: Mirren passive: Fortune's Favor. +25% part drop quality; chance to duplicate forged parts. Icon: a coin with fox ears.

kits/mirren_q.meaning: Mirren Q: Gilded Decoy. Taunting clone that explodes into coins and shrapnel. Icon: a fox mask bursting into coins.
kits/mirren_q.motif: a fox mask bursting into coins

kits/mirren_r.meaning: Mirren R (ultimate): Grand Heist. 6s where every kill drops bonus loot. Icon: a sack spilling coins.

kits/ossian_e.meaning: Ossian E: Skyhook Mortar. Arcing lob that splits into bomblets on landing. Icon: an arcing shell splitting into bomblets.
kits/ossian_e.motif: an arcing shell splitting into bomblets

kits/ossian_passive.meaning: Ossian passive: Marked Quarry. Damage stacks on a single target; switching targets resets. +30% damage to full-HP enemies. Icon: a reticle on a stag skull.
kits/ossian_passive.motif: a reticle on a stag skull

kits/ossian_q.meaning: Ossian Q: Piercing Comet. Charge shot that penetrates every enemy and wall in a line. Icon: a comet punching through a wall.
kits/ossian_q.motif: a comet punching through a wall

kits/ossian_r.meaning: Ossian R (ultimate): Rain of the Hunt. 5s of auto-crits on every Marked enemy, anywhere on screen. Icon: arrows falling on marks.

kits/selene_e.meaning: Selene E: Blink. Teleport through enemies, leaving a storm trail. Icon: a figure dissolving into shards behind a bolt.
kits/selene_e.motif: a figure dissolving into shards behind a bolt

kits/selene_passive.meaning: Selene passive: Static Charge. Movement builds charge; next Active deals bonus damage and chains. Icon: a bolt in a charging ring.
kits/selene_passive.motif: a bolt in a charging ring

kits/selene_q.meaning: Selene Q: Arc Nova. Chain-lightning burst that scales with your weapon's fire rate. Icon: a ring of bolts around a charged core.
kits/selene_q.motif: a ring of bolts around a charged core

kits/selene_r.meaning: Selene R (ultimate): Heaven's Verdict. Call a moving thunderstorm front that supercharges every ally's projectiles inside it. Icon: a storm cloud over three bolts.
kits/selene_r.motif: a storm cloud over three bolts

kits/seraph_e.meaning: Seraph E: Smite. A beam of judgement. Icon: a beam striking the ground.

kits/seraph_passive.meaning: Seraph passive: Judgement Marks. Marked enemies pay out bonus damage when allies strike them. Icon: the scales and the mark.

kits/seraph_q.meaning: Seraph Q: Aegis. Shield allies in a radius. Icon: a shield under a ward dome.
kits/seraph_q.motif: a shield under a ward dome

kits/seraph_r.meaning: Seraph R (ultimate): Verdict. Mark every enemy on screen. Icon: a gavel over marks.

kits/thessaly_e.meaning: Thessaly E: Binding Hex. Root field; enemies killed inside drop extra parts. Icon: a hex eye in a rune circle bound by a chain.
kits/thessaly_e.motif: a hex eye in a rune circle bound by a chain

kits/thessaly_passive.meaning: Thessaly passive: Curse Weaver. Debuffed enemies take +25% damage from all allies. Icon: a spindle and a hex eye.
kits/thessaly_passive.motif: a spindle and a hex eye

kits/thessaly_q.meaning: Thessaly Q: Forge Turret. Deploy a turret copying your weapon's Core + Mechanism at 40% power. Icon: a tripod turret.

kits/thessaly_r.meaning: Thessaly R (ultimate): Sabbath of Sparks. Turrets and Echoes surge; allies gain lifesteal against cursed targets. Icon: a candle in a ring of sparks.
kits/thessaly_r.motif: a candle in a ring of sparks

kits/valdris_e.meaning: Valdris E: Siege Stance. Plant yourself: fire rate +120%, incoming damage −40%, enemies target you. Icon: a planted tower shield with rising chevrons.
kits/valdris_e.motif: a planted tower shield with rising chevrons

kits/valdris_passive.meaning: Valdris passive: Reforged Flesh. Damage taken converts to Armor (max 50% mitigation). When armor breaks, emits a shockwave taunt. Icon: armour plates over a heart.

kits/valdris_q.meaning: Valdris Q: Bulwark Slam. Leap-slam: stun everything you land on and raise a forge barricade that blocks projectiles. Icon: a fist driving into the ground behind a raised barricade.
kits/valdris_q.motif: a fist driving into the ground behind a raised barricade

kits/valdris_r.meaning: Valdris R (ultimate): Mountainfall. Become a colossal anvil-avatar for 8s: every shot is an exploding boulder, ground pounds chain. Icon: a peak crowned by an anvil, a boulder falling.
kits/valdris_r.motif: a peak crowned by an anvil, a boulder falling

kits/vex_e.meaning: Vex E: Miasma Step. Dash leaves a toxic cloud. Icon: a footprint leaving a toxic cloud.
kits/vex_e.motif: a footprint leaving a toxic cloud

kits/vex_passive.meaning: Vex passive: Transmute. Corpses become bombs. Icon: a skull with a lit fuse.
kits/vex_passive.motif: a skull with a lit fuse

kits/vex_q.meaning: Vex Q: Bottle Toss. Lob a spreading plague flask. Icon: a flask arcing to a splash.
kits/vex_q.motif: a flask arcing to a splash

kits/vex_r.meaning: Vex R (ultimate): Red Death. Every corpse detonates for 6s. Icon: a skull in a burst.

parts/barbcore.meaning: Barbcore (Core): Barbed needles that catch and tear. Running only makes it worse. Icon: a barbed needle.

parts/blightcore.meaning: Blightcore (Core): Sickness that leaps from body to body. Nobody is patient zero twice. Icon: linked spores.

parts/cairncore.meaning: Cairncore (Core): Hurls grave-cairn stones that pin the living to the earth. Icon: a cairn of stones.

parts/dawncore.meaning: Dawncore (Core): Judgement shards that mark the guilty. Icon: the mark lozenge.

parts/embercore.meaning: Embercore (Core): Fire bolts that set the horde alight. Icon: a flame.

parts/gildcore.meaning: Gildcore (Core): Blessed gold. It always finds its way back into circulation. Icon: a coin with a rebound.

parts/gloamcore.meaning: Gloamcore (Core): Dusk-blades that pass through the living as if they were already ghosts. Icon: a dusk blade crescent.

parts/halocore.meaning: Halocore (Core): Small haloes that go looking for the guilty. Icon: a halo with a seeking arc.
parts/halocore.motif: a halo with a seeking arc

parts/hexcore.meaning: Hexcore (Core): Hex-needles that make the damned more damnable. Icon: a hex eye.

parts/ironcore.meaning: Ironcore (Core): Honest metal. Goes through the first one. Icon: a slug.

parts/kilncore.meaning: Kilncore (Core): Globes of liquid forge-fire that pool and keep on burning. Icon: a flame over a burning pool.
parts/kilncore.motif: a flame over a burning pool

parts/mech_arc_relay.meaning: Arc Relay (Mechanism): A conductor coil: every hit arcs on to two more. Icon: a conductor coil.

parts/mech_beam_sweep.meaning: Beam Sweep (Mechanism): Converts the weapon into a sweeping beam. Icon: a sweeping beam.

parts/mech_bounce_fork.meaning: Bounce-Fork (Mechanism): On first hit the shot splits into two forks. Icon: a shot splitting in two.

parts/mech_carrion_drift.meaning: Carrion Drift (Mechanism): Slow shots that circle like crows until they find meat. Icon: a circling crow.

parts/mech_choke_bore.meaning: Choke Bore (Mechanism): Tightens every spread and sends it further. Icon: a funnel narrowing the spread.

parts/mech_chorus_lattice.meaning: Chorus Lattice (Mechanism): Every other shot is sung back by a choir that died with its gods. Icon: two sung notes.

parts/mech_cleaving_fork.meaning: Cleaving Fork (Mechanism): On first hit the shot cleaves into three. Icon: a shot cleaving in three.

parts/mech_compass_rose.meaning: Compass Rose (Mechanism): Every shot erupts in a full circle, pointing everywhere at once. Icon: a compass rose.

parts/mech_deep_draw.meaning: Deep Draw (Mechanism): Hold longer. Hit harder. Go through. Icon: a deep draw piercing a bar.
parts/mech_deep_draw.motif: a deep draw piercing a bar

parts/mech_gatling_hymn.meaning: Gatling Hymn (Mechanism): A hymn with one very fast verse. Icon: a spinning barrel cluster.

parts/mech_heavy_hand.meaning: Heavy Hand (Mechanism): Fewer shots. Each lands like a verdict, and every blast grows to match. Icon: a fist driving down.

parts/mech_homing_shards.meaning: Homing Shards (Mechanism): Projectiles hunt their own targets. Icon: a curving shot finding a reticle.
parts/mech_homing_shards.motif: a curving shot finding a reticle

parts/mech_hydra_volley.meaning: Hydra Volley (Mechanism): Three more heads on every shot. Each one bites. Icon: three hydra heads.

parts/mech_impaler.meaning: Impaler (Mechanism): Skewers four in a row. Knockback all but vanishes, so the line holds still. Icon: a skewer through four.

parts/mech_lancet_drive.meaning: Lancet Drive (Mechanism): Shots pierce three enemies and fly faster. Icon: a shot through three bars.

parts/mech_multishot.meaning: Multishot (Mechanism): Two more projectiles per shot. Icon: three fanned arrows.

parts/mech_needle_ray.meaning: Needle Ray (Mechanism): Converts the weapon into a thin, far-reaching ray. Icon: a thin far ray.

parts/mech_overclock.meaning: Overclock (Mechanism): Faster. Hotter. Slightly less precise. Icon: a racing gear.

parts/mech_packhunt_volley.meaning: Packhunt Volley (Mechanism): Shots run as a pack: they spread, circle and go for the throat. Icon: shots running as a pack.

parts/mech_quickdraw_string.meaning: Quickdraw String (Mechanism): Charge weapons draw in half the time. Everything else just shoots a little faster. Icon: a fast-drawn bow.

parts/mech_railspike.meaning: Railspike (Mechanism): Hypervelocity spikes. Slow to load, impossible to dodge. Icon: a hypervelocity spike.

parts/mech_razor_halo.meaning: Razor Halo (Mechanism): Five razors spin tight around you. Hugging you is now a mistake. Icon: a halo of razors.

parts/mech_resounding_vault.meaning: Resounding Vault (Mechanism): Every third shot rings out twice. Icon: a ringing bell.

parts/mech_ricochet.meaning: Ricochet (Mechanism): Shots bounce to a new target after every hit. Icon: a bouncing path.

parts/mech_ricochet_rosary.meaning: Ricochet Rosary (Mechanism): Three bounces per shot, a prayer bead for each. Icon: rosary beads on a bouncing path.
parts/mech_ricochet_rosary.motif: rosary beads on a bouncing path

parts/mech_sawblade_orbit.meaning: Sawblade Orbit (Mechanism): Three forge-sawblades orbit you and shred anything close. Icon: three orbiting sawblades.

parts/mech_scatterburst.meaning: Scatterburst (Mechanism): A wide fan of five projectiles at close range. Icon: a wide fan of pellets.

parts/mech_seeker_swarm.meaning: Seeker Swarm (Mechanism): Shots scatter wide, then turn and hunt. Icon: shots that part and turn.

parts/mech_skipstone.meaning: Skipstone (Mechanism): Quick shots that skip once off the first thing they hit. Icon: a skipping stone.

parts/mech_split_carom.meaning: Split Carom (Mechanism): Bounces once, then splits. Geometry weeps. Icon: a bounce that splits.

parts/mech_sundering_payload.meaning: Sundering Payload (Mechanism): Every shot carries a charge of godfire that bursts on impact. Icon: a bursting shell.

parts/mech_titans_exhale.meaning: Titan's Exhale (Mechanism): Converts the weapon into a short, wide gout of force. Icon: a short wide gout.

parts/mech_tuning_fork.meaning: Tuning Fork (Mechanism): Two narrow tines ring on through the line at near-full strength. Icon: a ringing tuning fork.

parts/mech_twin_barrel.meaning: Twin Barrel (Mechanism): A second barrel, welded on by a smith who hated waiting. Icon: twin barrels.

parts/mech_whirling_anvils.meaning: Whirling Anvils (Mechanism): Two anvils swing around you on chains of light. They are heavy. So are you. Icon: two anvils on chains.

parts/miasmacore.meaning: Miasmacore (Core): Globes that weep a slowing fog behind them. Icon: a globe weeping fog.

parts/plaguecore.meaning: Plaguecore (Core): Slow globes that burst into festering pools. Icon: a drop over a festering pool.
parts/plaguecore.motif: a drop over a festering pool

parts/relic_anvil_plate.meaning: Anvil Plate (Relic): Take 15% less damage. Move like you are wearing an anvil, because you are. Icon: a breastplate stamped with an anvil.
parts/relic_anvil_plate.motif: a breastplate stamped with an anvil

parts/relic_ashen_covenant.meaning: Ashen Covenant (Relic): +35% damage to burning enemies. Pyra keeps her promises. Icon: a blade through a flame.

parts/relic_beating_stone.meaning: Beating Stone (Relic): +50 max health and slow regeneration. It beats when you forget to. Icon: a beating stone heart.

parts/relic_bloodletter.meaning: Bloodletter (Relic): Hits open wounds that bleed harder while enemies run. Icon: a lancet and drops.

parts/relic_brink_coin.meaning: Coin of the Brink (Relic): +60% damage below 30% health, and 30 less health to get you there sooner. Icon: a cracked coin with a skull.
parts/relic_brink_coin.motif: a cracked coin with a skull

parts/relic_cindertread.meaning: Cindertread (Relic): Every dash kicks up a burst of burning cinders. Icon: a boot kicking cinders.

parts/relic_coal_tongue_brand.meaning: Coal-Tongue Brand (Relic): Rarely catches. When it does, it catches twice. Icon: a branding iron with a flame.
parts/relic_coal_tongue_brand.motif: a branding iron with a flame

parts/relic_crooked_knucklebone.meaning: Crooked Knucklebone (Relic): Crits come often and land softer. The bones are crooked in your favour. Icon: a crooked knucklebone.

parts/relic_doomstack.meaning: Doomstack (Relic): Every hit stacks doom; eight stacks burst for heavy damage. Icon: doom stacks under a star.

parts/relic_dying_star.meaning: Dying Star (Relic): Now and then a kill collapses into a dying star and takes the whole crowd with it. Icon: a star collapsing inward.

parts/relic_ember_of_ruin.meaning: Ember of Ruin (Relic): +45% damage while below 40% health. Umbra-Rex approves of your choices. Icon: a cracked heart with an ember.
parts/relic_ember_of_ruin.motif: a cracked heart with an ember

parts/relic_epitaph_engine.meaning: Epitaph Engine (Relic): Twelve hits write the epitaph. The last one reads it aloud. Icon: a gravestone tallying.

parts/relic_executioners_seal.meaning: Executioner's Seal (Relic): Hits kill non-boss enemies below 12% health. Icon: a headsman's axe on a seal.
parts/relic_executioners_seal.motif: a headsman's axe on a seal

parts/relic_frostwake.meaning: Frostwake (Relic): Projectiles leave chilling trails that slow the horde. Icon: a slowing wake.

parts/relic_funeral_bell.meaning: Funeral Bell (Relic): Every fifth hit tolls the bell. Small bursts, but it never stops ringing. Icon: a funeral bell.

parts/relic_giantsbane.meaning: Giantsbane (Relic): +35% damage against elites and bosses. Icon: a horned helm split by a sword.
parts/relic_giantsbane.motif: a horned helm split by a sword

parts/relic_gilded_aegis.meaning: Gilded Aegis (Relic): A regenerating shield of beaten god-gold. Icon: a round shield with a sun boss.
parts/relic_gilded_aegis.motif: a round shield with a sun boss

parts/relic_greedstone.meaning: Greedstone (Relic): Godshards fall like rain. Better parts too. Icon: a stone shedding coins.

parts/relic_gyrestone.meaning: Gyrestone (Relic): Every blast, well, pool and burst you make grows by a third. Icon: a spiral stone in widening rings.
parts/relic_gyrestone.motif: a spiral stone in widening rings

parts/relic_headsmans_hood.meaning: Headsman's Hood (Relic): +90% crit damage. Take your time. Aim for the neck. Icon: a headsman's hood.

parts/relic_heirs_oath.meaning: Heir's Oath (Relic): An oath of law: shield the faithful, mark the guilty. Icon: a shield bearing the mark.

parts/relic_hexnail.meaning: Hexnail (Relic): A coffin nail. Every hit drives the curse a little deeper. Icon: a coffin nail under a hex eye.
parts/relic_hexnail.motif: a coffin nail under a hex eye

parts/relic_hound9_spares.meaning: Hound-9's Spare Parts (Relic): Crits often spawn tiny, short-lived turrets. Hound-9 would like them back. Icon: little turrets and a spare gear.
parts/relic_hound9_spares.motif: little turrets and a spare gear

parts/relic_huntmothers_fang.meaning: Huntmother's Fang (Relic): A fang from something that hunted gods. It still knows the big ones. Icon: a great fang.

parts/relic_ichor_chalice.meaning: Ichor Chalice (Relic): A cup of god-blood. +30 max health and a steady trickle of healing. Icon: a chalice of god-blood.

parts/relic_last_chorus_bell.meaning: Bell of the Last Chorus (Relic): It rings for gods who are not coming back. Every fourth shot rings with it. Icon: a bell and a note.

parts/relic_ledger_of_sins.meaning: Ledger of Sins (Relic): +30% damage to cursed enemies. Every sin is itemised. Icon: an open ledger with a hex eye.
parts/relic_ledger_of_sins.motif: an open ledger with a hex eye

parts/relic_leech_crown.meaning: Leech Crown (Relic): Drink deep: 6% lifesteal, but you take 12% more damage. Icon: a dripping crown.

parts/relic_misericorde.meaning: Misericorde (Relic): The mercy blade ends anything below 15% health. It hates starting fights. Icon: a mercy blade.

parts/relic_nyctian_eye.meaning: Nyctian Eye (Relic): See the weak point. Hit it. Icon: an eye with a lozenge pupil.
parts/relic_nyctian_eye.motif: an eye with a lozenge pupil

parts/relic_opening_verse.meaning: Opening Verse (Relic): +45% damage to enemies at full health. Make an entrance. Icon: an arrow in a whole target.
parts/relic_opening_verse.motif: an arrow in a whole target

parts/relic_pinning_stake.meaning: Pinning Stake (Relic): +50% damage to rooted enemies. Hold still, this will only hurt a lot. Icon: a stake driven into roots.

parts/relic_pyre_lung.meaning: Pyre Lung (Relic): Half of all kills cough out a small, hot burst. Icon: lungs with a flame.

parts/relic_quarry_brand.meaning: Quarry Brand (Relic): Brands your quarry. Hits against the Marked find the weak point. Icon: a branding iron with the mark.
parts/relic_quarry_brand.motif: a branding iron with the mark

parts/relic_razorwake.meaning: Razorwake (Relic): Projectiles leave a wake of razor-light that cuts whatever crosses it. Icon: a razor and its wake.

parts/relic_reapers_tithe.meaning: Reaper's Tithe (Relic): Finishes enemies below 8% health and takes a godshard for the trouble. Icon: a scythe taking a shard.

parts/relic_reddeath_alembic.meaning: Reddeath Alembic (Relic): Distils the recently dead into something far more useful: bombs. Icon: an alembic with a skull.

parts/relic_rootbinders_knot.meaning: Rootbinder's Knot (Relic): Hits can bind enemies to the ground. Knockback softens so they stay put. Icon: roots bound by a ring.

parts/relic_salt_the_wound.meaning: Salt the Wound (Relic): +25% damage to bleeding enemies, and a sip of whatever spills. Icon: a blade through blood drops.

parts/relic_scale_of_judgement.meaning: Scale of Judgement (Relic): +35% damage to Marked enemies. The scale only ever tips one way. Icon: scales tipping on the mark.

parts/relic_sentry_seed.meaning: Sentry Seed (Relic): Crits rarely plant a sturdy forge-sentry that fights on for six seconds. Icon: a seed sprouting a turret.

parts/relic_splitspawn.meaning: Splitspawn (Relic): Critical hits can spawn a short-lived turret. Icon: a turret sprung from a crit.
parts/relic_splitspawn.motif: a turret sprung from a crit

parts/relic_stormcatcher.meaning: Stormcatcher (Relic): +35% damage to shocked enemies. The storm always knows where to go. Icon: a lightning rod.

parts/relic_stormglass_phial.meaning: Stormglass Phial (Relic): Bottled thunder. Hits build static that discharges in bursts. Icon: a phial holding a bolt.

parts/relic_tarpit_heart.meaning: Tarpit Heart (Relic): Impacts leave pitch pools that hold the horde fast. Icon: a heart sinking in pitch.

parts/relic_titanbreaker_wedge.meaning: Titanbreaker Wedge (Relic): +60% damage to elites and bosses, at the expense of the small fry. Icon: a wedge splitting a boulder.

parts/relic_vampire.meaning: Vampire (Relic): Return 4% of damage dealt as health. Icon: a fanged drop.

parts/relic_volatile_heart.meaning: Volatile Heart (Relic): Kills sometimes detonate. Icon: a spiked, bursting heart.

parts/shrapnelcore.meaning: Shrapnelcore (Core): On first hit every shot bursts into three shards of dead-god iron. Icon: a shot bursting into shards.

parts/sigil_anvilheart.meaning: Sigil of the Anvilheart (Sigil): Gaiaa's stone beats in your chest. Icon: a heart stamped with an anvil.
parts/sigil_anvilheart.motif: a heart stamped with an anvil

parts/sigil_borrowed_hour.meaning: Sigil of the Borrowed Hour (Sigil): Time runs faster for you. Icon: an hourglass and a stride arrow.
parts/sigil_borrowed_hour.motif: an hourglass and a stride arrow

parts/sigil_bound_souls.meaning: Sigil of Bound Souls (Sigil): Where your shots land the ground itself curses. Icon: a hex eye over a pool.
parts/sigil_bound_souls.motif: a hex eye over a pool

parts/sigil_cadence.meaning: Sigil of Cadence (Sigil): Every 4th shot echoes. Icon: three beats and a spark.

parts/sigil_colossal_echo.meaning: Sigil of the Colossal Echo (Sigil): Ults leave burning ground. Icon: a flame over scarred ground.

parts/sigil_far_sight.meaning: Sigil of Far Sight (Sigil): See further. Strike sooner. Icon: an eye and a long arrow.
parts/sigil_far_sight.motif: an eye and a long arrow

parts/sigil_furnace_heart.meaning: Sigil of the Furnace Heart (Sigil): Everything you touch catches. Icon: a heart with a flame.

parts/sigil_ghostlight.meaning: Sigil of Ghostlight (Sigil): One more step between worlds. Icon: dash chevrons.

parts/sigil_gilded_tongue.meaning: Sigil of the Gilded Tongue (Sigil): Fortune listens when you talk. Icon: a four-leaf charm.

parts/sigil_hexlace.meaning: Sigil of Hexlace (Sigil): Every hit laces a curse. Icon: laced threads over a hex eye.
parts/sigil_hexlace.motif: laced threads over a hex eye

parts/sigil_huntmark.meaning: Sigil of the Huntmark (Sigil): The hunt-god chooses your quarry. Icon: an antler and the mark.

parts/sigil_iron_knuckle.meaning: Sigil of the Iron Knuckle (Sigil): Hit them so hard they remember it next run. Icon: a fist.

parts/sigil_loaded_dice.meaning: Sigil of Loaded Dice (Sigil): Fate owes you one. Icon: a die.

parts/sigil_meltpoint.meaning: Sigil of Meltpoint (Sigil): +25% damage to burning enemies. Icon: a melting drop over a flame.
parts/sigil_meltpoint.motif: a melting drop over a flame

parts/sigil_nightfall.meaning: Sigil of Nightfall (Sigil): Nyctia guides the killing blow. Icon: a crescent and a spark.

parts/sigil_patient_death.meaning: Sigil of Patient Death (Sigil): The first hit is the one that matters. Icon: an hourglass and a blade.

parts/sigil_pickpocket.meaning: Sigil of the Pickpocket (Sigil): The dead don't need godshards. Icon: a hand lifting a shard.

parts/sigil_quaking_step.meaning: Sigil of the Quaking Step (Sigil): Every dash lands like an earthquake. Icon: a quaking footprint.

parts/sigil_second_hand.meaning: Sigil of the Second Hand (Sigil): Every 5th shot happens twice. Icon: a clock and a spark.

parts/sigil_silent_edge.meaning: Sigil of the Silent Edge (Sigil): The wounded simply stop. Icon: a quiet dagger.

parts/sigil_skyrender.meaning: Sigil of the Skyrender (Sigil): The storm never waits. Icon: a wing.

parts/sigil_slow_rot.meaning: Sigil of Slow Rot (Sigil): Your shots age the world they pass through. Icon: a wilting stem.

parts/sigil_static_bloom.meaning: Sigil of Static Bloom (Sigil): Hits build shock that discharges in bursts. Icon: a bloom of bolts.

parts/sigil_tinkers_grace.meaning: Sigil of Tinker's Grace (Sigil): Your contraptions are always ready. Icon: a gear and an hourglass.

parts/slagcore.meaning: Slagcore (Core): Molten slag that bursts where it lands. The Slag King's leftovers. Icon: a molten burst.

parts/squallcore.meaning: Squallcore (Core): Lightning that splits the moment it finds flesh. Icon: a forked bolt.

parts/stormcore.meaning: Stormcore (Core): Chain arcs leap between the damned. Icon: a bolt.

parts/tempestcore.meaning: Tempestcore (Core): Fast bolts that fill the damned with static until they burst. Icon: a bolt with static sparks.

parts/unmadecore.meaning: Unmadecore (Core): A splinter pried from the Unmaking. It will not stay one thing for long. Icon: a splinter breaking apart.

parts/verdictcore.meaning: Verdictcore (Core): Radiant slugs that strike the Marked like a final ruling. Icon: a slug in a mark.

parts/vitriolcore.meaning: Vitriolcore (Core): Alchemical globes that shatter, splash and linger. Vex's favourite solvent. Icon: a cracked flask.

parts/voidcore.meaning: Voidcore (Core): Impacts open gravity wells that drag enemies together. Icon: a gravity spiral.

parts/wickcore.meaning: Wickcore (Core): Every shot drags a burning fuse behind it. The floor remembers. Icon: a lit fuse.
